headline: Traffic Commission to review stop sign, crosswalk, and RRFB requests plus the Bay Colony transportation evaluation on Winter Street.

plain_text:
AGENDA OF THE TRAFFIC COMMISSION MEETING 
TO BE HELD: THURSDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2026 AT 10:00 A.M. 
WALTHAM CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER, CITY HALL 
 
The Chair will accept a motion to accept the minutes of the previous meeting(s). 
 
1. PETITIONED ITEMS:  
A. Bacon Street at Plympton Street/Athletic Field Road (Councillor LaFauci) 
Councillor LaFauci is requesting that the intersection of Bacon Street with Plympton 
Street/Athletic Field Road be controlled by All-Way STOP. 
 
   
B. New Crosswalk Crossing Summit Street (Councillor Durkee) 
Councillor Durkee is requesting installation of a new crosswalk crossing Summit Street at Irving 
Street/Tomlin Street. 
 
   
C. Request for RRFB on South Street (Councillor Katz) 
Councillor Katz is requesting a new RRFB be installed for the crosswalk crossing South Street 
between Hartwell Street and Angleside Road. 
 
   
D. Request for RRFB on Trapelo Road (Councillor Hanley) 
Councillor Hanley is requesting a new RRFB be installed for the crosswalk crossing Trapelo 
Road at Briarwood Road. 
 
   
E. Comprehensive Bay Colony Transportation Evaluation 
BXP has submitted the transportation evaluation for the full Bay Colony conceptual 
development plan used in approving zoning overlay district along Winter Street. 
 
   
F. Warren Street Traffic Calming 
A citizen petition has been submitted asking for traffic calming measures on Warren Street. 
 
   
G. 15 th Annual Piggy’s 5K Road Race (Saturday November 21st) 
Approval is requested for this road race. 
 
   
H. Disabled Parking Space Request, 31 Brigham Rd 
A disabled parking space is requested. 
 
   
I. Disabled Parking Space Request, 23 Elson Rd 
A disabled parking space is requested.
